decision_basis.claim: The runtime source-of-truth default universe is 22 symbols.
decision_basis.evidence: btc_scraper/core/config.py DEFAULT_ANALYSIS_UNIVERSE contains BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, ZEC, XRP, DOGE, WLD, XLM, NEAR, AVAX, TAO, TRB, AEVO, ENA, AR, IOTA, XPL, SOPH, XAUT, TRX, TRUMP.

decision_basis.claim: P7/R4 evidence shows the current runtime analysis/execution symbols are the same 22-symbol universe.
decision_basis.evidence: runtime_activation_p7_r4_symbol_compatibility.json compatibility.runtime_symbols and compatibility.runtime_execution_symbols each contain 22 symbols.

decision_basis.claim: Artifact metadata advertises the same 22-symbol support set.
decision_basis.evidence: runtime_activation_p7_r4_symbol_compatibility.json compatibility.artifact_supported_symbols contains 22 symbols and unsupported_by_artifact_metadata is empty.

decision_basis.claim: Actual inference routes are only BTC, ETH, and BNB.
decision_basis.evidence: runtime_activation_p7_r4_symbol_compatibility.json compatibility.model_route_supported_symbols is [BNB, BTC, ETH], with 19 unsupported runtime symbols.

decision_basis.claim: Shrinking runtime to 3 symbols would modify a CRITICAL shared runtime contract rather than merely correcting activation plumbing.
decision_basis.evidence: GitNexus CLI impact for get_analysis_universe/parse_runtime_symbols reports CRITICAL risk across runtime, diagnostics, backtests, baseline scripts, evidence epoch management, and tests.

forbidden_inference: Do not treat the observed 3-symbol model route as canonical merely because it is the only working path.
Do not silently downgrade the already-bound 22-symbol runtime/manifest/epoch contract to 3 symbols.
Do not create fallback aliases such as SOL -> BTC.
Do not skip unsupported runtime symbols while leaving them canonical.
successor_effect: P7 remains blocked until explicit model/artifact coverage exists for every canonical runtime symbol or governance separately authorizes a new canonical universe contract.
